_about: One content source for winchxyz.github.io and the GitHub profile README (draft 2026-11-13). Order (the user's, 2026-11-14): Tools (one section, More tools and X tools merged), then the Hermes plugins, then the visual tools, then games and the rest. short = one line for README tiles (50 chars max), line = the longer site copy. Images: assets/p/<id>.jpg (720x450).
line: I build tools: tools for AI agents and X, plugins for Hermes Agent, and visual tools that run in your browser.
stats: tools for AI agents, X and 3D printing
plugins in the Hermes Agent catalog

sections.title: Tools
sections.line: For building with Claude Code and agents, posting on X, making videos and 3D printing.

sections.title: Hermes plugins
sections.line: Four plugins for Hermes Agent, all in its official plugin catalog.

sections.title: Visual tools
sections.line: Turn a picture into something else. Everything runs in your browser, and your pictures are not uploaded.

sections.title: Games and graphics
sections.line: Side projects. Most have no asset files: every mesh, texture and sound is made in code.

hermes-x-bookmarks.short: Your X bookmarks, sorted and kept in your notes.
hermes-x-bookmarks.line: Reads every X bookmark, threads and Articles too, sorts them with your own model and keeps them in Notion, Obsidian, Google Docs or a desktop board.
hermes-x-bookmarks.label: Code

hermes-ghost-call.short: Listens to your call and whispers hints to you.
hermes-ghost-call.line: You stay on the call. Hermes listens, whispers one-line hints to you only, and sends one summary when you hang up.
hermes-ghost-call.label: Code

hermes-phone.short: Makes the phone call for you and reports back.
hermes-phone.line: Hermes makes the call you keep putting off. When it needs an answer it asks you in chat, then sends the result and the transcript.
hermes-phone.label: Code

hermes-blueprint.short: Turns a raw idea into a plan you can build.
hermes-blueprint.line: From a raw idea to a plan you can build: research with sources, a critic that does not cave, and estimates in hours.
hermes-blueprint.label: Code

afterglyph.short: Pictures and video as glowing glyph art, in 3D.
afterglyph.line: Turn any image, GIF or video into glowing glyph art you can spin in 3D. Save it as a video, a GIF or text.
afterglyph.label: Open

nightgrain.short: Pictures and video as shimmering pixel art.
nightgrain.line: Turn any image, GIF or video into dithered pixel art that shimmers. Save a PNG, GIF, MP4 or a Telegram sticker.
nightgrain.label: Open

spiralist.short: A photo drawn with one continuous line.
spiralist.line: Draws your photo as one continuous line, then films it being drawn.
spiralist.label: Open

typist.short: Photo to text art for Instagram, X and Telegram.
typist.line: Turn any photo into text art you can paste into Instagram, X and Telegram.
typist.label: Open

pasteup.short: Lay out pictures for X before you post them.
pasteup.line: Lay out pictures for X before you post: rows of up to 20, one picture cut into strips, avatar and banner.
pasteup.label: Open

mosaiz.short: Any photo as a real mosaic you can build.
mosaiz.line: Turn any photo into a real mosaic: 3D preview, build video and a numbered 3D-print kit.
mosaiz.label: Open

seedplot.short: Five art styles. Same seed, same picture.
seedplot.line: A drawing machine that works from a seed: five algorithmic art styles, same seed, same picture.
seedplot.label: Open

platen.line: A cozy 3D typewriter. Write, draw typewriter art, or get a guide to type it on your own machine.
platen.label: Open

loupe.short: AI makes the site, you fix it by hand.
loupe.line: A local website builder for Windows. AI makes the site, you fix it by hand on the live page.
loupe.label: Site

idea-to-build.short: A Claude Code plugin: raw idea to a build plan.
idea-to-build.line: A Claude Code plugin that turns a raw idea into a plan you can build.
idea-to-build.label: Code

crunch-time.short: Your Claude Code agents in a PS1-style office.
crunch-time.line: Watch your Claude Code agents work in a PS1-style low-poly office. Live via hooks, zero tokens.
crunch-time.label: Open

motion-studio.short: One brief in, a finished motion video out.
motion-studio.line: One brief in, a finished motion video out. A Claude Code workflow where every frame is code.
motion-studio.label: Code

mc-print-3d.line: A desktop app that turns Minecraft schematics into multi-colour, print-ready 3D models with the real block textures.
mc-print-3d.label: Code

follower-sweep.short: Finds dead followers on X, within X's rules.
follower-sweep.line: A Chrome extension that finds dead followers on X and marks them for you, within X's rules.
follower-sweep.label: Open

draft-desk.short: Grok researches, Claude drafts, Telegram asks you.
draft-desk.line: An n8n pipeline: Grok researches X, Claude drafts posts and replies in your voice, Telegram hands you a one-tap button.
draft-desk.label: Code

x-ghostwriter.short: Drafts X posts in your voice. You press publish.
x-ghostwriter.line: Drafts X posts and replies in your voice, locally and for free. You always press publish.
x-ghostwriter.label: Code

moon-rover.short: Drive a rover across the Moon.
moon-rover.line: A 3D lunar rover survey game. Every texture and sound is generated at runtime.
moon-rover.label: Play

tidewright.short: Sandcastles on a beach that runs on the GPU.
tidewright.line: A 3D sandcastle simulator that runs entirely on the GPU. No engine, no libraries, no asset files.
tidewright.label: Play

tria-prima.short: A dark-fantasy alchemy game in first person.
tria-prima.line: A dark-fantasy alchemy adventure in first person. Fully procedural, plays in the browser.
tria-prima.label: Play

celadon.short: A pottery game: wheel, glaze chemistry, kiln.
celadon.line: A pottery game. Throw a pot on the wheel, mix the glaze chemistry, fire the kiln.
celadon.label: Play

crayon-contraptions.short: A Rube Goldberg puzzle game drawn in crayon.
crayon-contraptions.line: A Rube Goldberg puzzle game drawn in crayon: 100 levels and seven crayons with their own physics.
crayon-contraptions.label: Play

navis.short: A flooded Gothic cathedral in one HTML file.
navis.line: A flooded Gothic cathedral rendered in real time, from one HTML file with no assets.
navis.label: Open

vesper-street.short: Survival horror in a drowned voxel town.

endless-fishing.short: An ocean under tonight's real sky.

aetherflow.short: A GPU fluid lab with caustics.

ant-farm.short: An ant farm on a hand-written WebGL2 engine.

cut.short: Slice objects along your mouse path.

pudgy-torture-simulator.name: pudgy sim
pudgy-torture-simulator.short: The same sandbox, with a penguin.

bikini-bottom.short: A cel-shaded town grown from a seed.

solebound.short: A shoe-repair sim about roads that remember.

credits-cubed.short: A picture cube made from Credits.

ar-butter.short: Crack butter with your hands through a webcam.

motion-reels.short: Short motion videos made with AI and code.
